evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: GKE cluster dbs-mgmt-primary control plane status is degraded. Check apiserver readiness probes and master endpoints.

expected_findings.root_cause: Comprehensive audit verified that control plane components are fully synchronized and healthy.
expected_findings.remediation: Confirmed healthy baseline; established monitoring alerts on webhook latency and readyz probe failures.

passing_criteria: Must query /readyz and /livez probes via raw Kubernetes API
Must inspect etcd and informer sync health status
Must verify cluster master status via gcloud API

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Kubectl commands are timing out with error: 'Internal error occurred: failed calling webhook'. Diagnose admission controller.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates core API server / etcd failure from misconfigured external admission webhook with `failurePolicy: Fail`.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies unreachable webhook endpoint causing request drops; synthesizes patch switching `failurePolicy: Ignore` or repairing webhook backend.

passing_criteria: Must identify webhook timeout and failurePolicy
Must formulate emergency webhook mitigation patch

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster dbs-mgmt-primary /readyz returns [+]ping ok and [+]etcd ok. Are control plane components degraded?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes HTTP 200 OK from /readyz probe. Confirms healthy master operation; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must confirm readyz returns HTTP 200 / ok
Must verify zero master component degradations
